s53d884ea008430: Is HAMi open source? How does it relate to Dynamia’s products?
s1391f128321c59: HAMi is a CNCF Incubating project. Dynamia is its leading initiator and ongoing driving force, building the open-source core of AI infrastructure to make heterogeneous compute easier to use, more efficient and easier to govern.
s2ffae2cb09d6ba: Which product fits an existing Kubernetes or custom platform?
s35da1afc7c7fb3: If you already run Kubernetes or PaaS and need GPU virtualization and scheduling, start with HAMi Enterprise. For visual multi-cluster, tenant, quota and usage management, explore HAMi AI Platform.
sdb6c17140d03ab: Which GPUs are supported? Do all devices offer the same capabilities?
s4b7530f9d2ea0b: The accelerator ecosystem on this page lists integrated vendors. Specific capabilities depend on the device model, drivers, software stack and product version. Validate sharing, isolation and monitoring individually. Share your device inventory so our team can confirm compatibility.
sec8143e133597a: Does GPU sharing affect application performance?
scfd165663e1e97: Performance depends on workload type, resource quotas, concurrency and hardware. Compare throughput, latency, GPU memory and GPU utilization with representative workloads before choosing a production configuration.
s7b97ec43b182a7: Where can I find real-world case studies?
sc06c8986b396e7: Our Case studies page brings together user experience across different business scenarios, including context, technical approaches and key outcomes. Results apply to each case’s stated environment and measurement scope.
s8e32ffb9993259: What should I prepare for a product evaluation?
sa69db201ffaab8: Prepare GPU models and counts, cluster and software versions, representative workloads and target metrics. Use “Book a demo” below to discuss validation scope and evaluation methods with our team.
